title: Egyptian Fava Bean Fritters
description: A traditional Egyptian recipe using fava beans, perfect as a snack or side dish.

ingredients.name: egyptian spices
ingredients.notes: such as cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: In a large bowl, mash the fava beans using a fork or a potato masher.
In a separate bowl, mix the cornmeal, flour, Egyptian spices, bean flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add the water or buttermilk to the dry ingredients and mix until a thick batter forms.
Add the mashed fava beans to the batter and mix until well combined.
Heat about 1-2 inches of oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for about 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
